```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)






# 8.1. Import data


# Set file paths
data_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"

# Import data
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "patient_info_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F,
  check.names=F,
  row.names=1
)

# Align metadata and protein matrix
metadata_df_with_folds <- metadata_df_with_folds %>%
  filter(patient_id %in% rownames(protein_mat)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient_id")

protein_mat <- protein_mat[rownames(metadata_df_with_folds), ]






# 8.2. Limma DA


# Define LRTI adjudication
metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication <- factor(
  metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication,
  levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
)

metadata_df_with_folds$sex <- factor(
  metadata_df_with_folds$sex
)

metadata_df_with_folds$age_in_years <- as.numeric(
  metadata_df_with_folds$age_in_years
)

# Create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ LRTI_adjudication + age_in_years + sex,
  data = metadata_df_with_folds
)

# Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(
  t(protein_mat),
  design
)

fit <- eBayes(fit)

# Extract differential abundance results
res_df <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef = "LRTI_adjudicationDefinite",
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    padj = adj.P.Val,
    log2FoldChange = logFC,
    negLog10P = -log10(padj + 1e-300),
    sig = padj < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      sig & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "LRTI",
      sig & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ "NotSignificant"
    )
  )






# 8.3. Volcano Plot


# Select proteins to label
label_data <- bind_rows(
  res_df %>%
    filter(direction == "LRTI") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange)), padj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10),
  res_df %>%
    filter(direction == "Control") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange)), padj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
)


# Volcano plot
volcano_plot_prot <- ggplot(
  res_df,
  aes(
    x = log2FoldChange,
    y = negLog10P
  )
) +

  # Points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = direction),
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "LRTI" = "#D55E00",
      "Control" = "#8B4789",
      "NotSignificant" = "grey85"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # FDR threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Fold-change reference lines
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-1, 1),
    linetype = "dotted",
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # Gene/protein labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_data,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "plain",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.7,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    segment.size = 0.3
  ) +

  # Direction arrows
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = -0.3,
    xend = -1.7,
    y = 6.0,
    yend = 6.0,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    colour = "#8B4789",
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      type = "closed"
    )
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -1.0,
    y = 5.7,
    label = "Downregulated in LRTI",
    size = 3.8,
    colour = "#8B4789"
  ) +

  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 0.3,
    xend = 1.7,
    y = 6.0,
    yend = 6.0,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    colour = "#D55E00",
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.18, "cm"),
      type = "closed"
    )
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.0,
    y = 5.7,
    label = "Upregulated in LRTI",
    size = 3.8,
    colour = "#D55E00"
  ) +

  # DE protein count
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0,
    y = 3.9,
    label = paste0(
      format(sum(res_df$sig), big.mark = ","),
      " DA proteins"
    ),
    size = 3.8,
    family = "Arial",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # Theme
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12,
    base_family = "Arial"
  ) +

  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      colour = "black",
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      colour = "black",
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain",
      colour = "black",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = expression(log[2]*" fold change"),
    y = expression(-log[10](P[adj])),
    title = "Proteomic differential abundance"
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15))
  )


print(volcano_plot_prot)


# Save results
write.csv(
  res_df,
  file.path(results_dir, "DA_results_proteomics.csv"),
  row.names = F
)


# Save editable vector PDF
ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "volcano_proteome.pdf"),
  volcano_plot_prot,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 6.5,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)

# Save plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(
  volcano_plot_prot,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "volcano_proteome.rds"
  )
)




```
